title: Exact‑LP SA ablation: q=10s, Q=80, margins=0.035/0.055, step0=0.04
abstract: Ablation of exact‑accept SA: faster quenches (10s, 80 tries), tighter margins (0.035/0.055), step0=0.04, two‑phase step schedule. 9‑minute budget with fixed seed.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_exact_params as P

def construct_packing():
    centers, radii, score = P.exact_sa_params(
        budget_sec=540.0,
        seed=20251031,
        step0=0.04,
        ar_lo=0.16, ar_hi=0.28,
        quench_interval=10.0, quench_tries=80,
        margins=(0.035, 0.055),
        two_phase=True,
        step_minmax_phase1=(0.008, 0.08),
        step_minmax_phase2=(0.004, 0.04),
    )
    # validity
    assert centers.shape == (26,2)
    assert radii.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(radii > 0)
    x, y = centers[:,0], centers[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(radii <= b + 1e-9)
    return centers, radii
